newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rally late, little change elsewhere.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rally late, little change elsewhere.

text.p: ARA bunker price shot up late on Tuesday on reports of refinery difficulties, catching out other markets which were largely stable, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST initially traded at $94/$95 fob, but rose rapidly through the afternoon to around $99 fob. The strength emerged in the barge market as one major bought large volumes of high sulphur cracked fuel oil in response to what traders said was a technical problem.
Bunker market activity, however, was confined to the morning, in which a number of enquiries emerged, resulting in a few deals before afternoon calm.
"It was absolutely dead after lunch," one dealer said.
Hamburg prices were little changed in line with early Rotterdam quotes. Traders said prices should push up on Wednesday if Rotterdam held.
In the Mediterranean, bunkers mostly held at the lower levels seen on Monday. Demand was thin as buyers expected further price falls.
